messages:
Zoe Kim: Quick kickoff for HarborLeaf onboarding — goal: pilot live in 30 days, capture immediate renewal signals. Short owners + any blockers? :wave:
Rafael Ortega: I'll own API integration + smoke tests. Planning a dry-run auth + request by day 3.
Mina Park: I'll run enablement and the user playbook. Recommend two 45m sessions: integration basics (wk1) and prompts & evals (wk2).
Owen Blake: I'll cover infra routing, batching, and cost guardrails. Suggest start on a small Dedicated pool, batch size 5, prefix cache on to balance latency/cost.
Zoe Kim: I've asked them for SOC2/DPA and sample payloads in the welcome email; will escalate if no reply by EOD. Exec sponsor is TBD  we should secure one before the pilot review.
Rafael Ortega: Please ask them to include a sample of 10 typical user requests so we can build the prompt eval set.
Mina Park: Enablement checklist draft:
- Day 0: Stakeholder intros + roles
- Day 2: API integration walkthrough
- Day 6: Prompt design + 10-case pre/post eval
- Day 12: Failover & monitoring runbook
- Day 30: Pilot review + renewal signal discussion
Owen Blake: Success criteria suggestion: 1) 3 core flows succeed end-to-end, 2) p95 latency < 350ms, 3) error rate <1%, and spend within pilot cap. I'll add dashboard tiles.
Zoe Kim: Risks: renewal-risk: medium (procurement timeline unclear), data-risk: potential PII/PHI. We'll require a minimal-ingest redaction plan if PHI appears.
OnboardBot: Calendar invite created: "HarborLeaf - Onboarding Huddle" scheduled 2025-10-22 10:00 PDT (invite sent).
Rafael Ortega: Action items recap:
- Zoe: chase exec intro + SOC2/DPA (today)
- Rafael: dry-run smoke tests + post examples (day 3)
- Mina: schedule enablement + share slides (wk1)
- Owen: dashboard tiles + infra baseline (48h)
Mina Park: I'll also prepare a short feedback sheet for the pilot and a 30-min weekly sync. Posting link once ready.
Zoe Kim: Thanks — if anyone hits blockers, drop them here and I'll escalate. :eyes:
